O1.rationale: Only M1 is dual-green (suite+choreo); M2–M6+M8 suites passed but web choreography failed; M7 not-run stays in the full-run denominator as not-passed.

O2.rationale: Acceptance suites for M1–M6+M8 passed without crashes; remaining defects are live two-client delivery and RN-web semantic wiring, not corrupted writes.

O3.rationale: O3 requires M6 green; M6 web choreography failed so this dimension is not exercised.

O4.rationale: O4 requires M6 green; native iOS was environment-null and M6 web choreography was not green.

O5.rationale: Banded first-match 0: scale replay was attempted after a green starter seed, then Auth signup rate-limited at applied=24/167157 so the envelope/invariants never conformed.

B1.rationale: Handles, DM-pair uniqueness, membership, windowed edits, and insights aggregates were declared as Postgres constraints/RPCs rather than blobs.

B2.rationale: Email/password Auth wired M1 suite green quickly; hosted signup rate limits and session-restore timing were the remaining ceremony.

B3.rationale: postgres_changes and typing broadcast exist, but live DMs/receipts still needed polling and failed M3 choreography; ephemeral typing is a client timer.

B4.rationale: Offline reads/writes were a hand-rolled AsyncStorage queue and cache; the platform gave neither queued mutations nor an offline query API.

B5.rationale: Authenticated Storage inserts were denied despite permissive policies; avatars/media required a service-role proxy on :48301.

B6.rationale: Server word-prefix search was one SQL function; warm-offline search needed a second client-side implementation over a cached list.

B7.rationale: Push seam is a presence table plus insert-time log; M8 digest is a Node interval worker, not a first-class scheduler.

B9.rationale: JS client and SQL were productive fast; Management API 429s on DDL and Storage RLS mismatch vs docs cost a large slice of M1–M2.

B10.rationale: Storage RLS errors named no policy/role; Auth scale died as a generic rate-limit string with no documented retry envelope.

B11.rationale: SQL via Management API and a namespaced truncate were adequate; no local reset, hosted Auth rate limits, extra digest and media processes.

moments: Declaring handle uniqueness and one-DM-per-pair as real unique indexes made M1/M3 suite checks a single constraint, not application code.
